title: Emergent Steering Beyond Endpoint Alignment in Chemical Reaction Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21423v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning models for chemical reaction prediction are usually evaluated by endpoint accuracy, but endpoint correctness alone does not reveal how a model represents chemical transformation or why it fails. We introduce UniRxnAxis, a unified forward-retrosynthesis framework that models both tasks as direction-conditioned endpoint redistribution in a shared latent space. By aligning source states, transformed states, and encoded target endpoints, UniRxnAxis enables directional auditing of learned latent updates. This shared latent geometry allows the learned displacement (from the encoder source state $S_0$ to the decoder-facing transformed state $S_1$) to be decomposed into an endpoint-parallel component and an endpoint-orthogonal residual, which we call emergent steering. Our evaluation shows that emergent steering is functionally important: in retrosynthesis, it recovers most of the model's utility, remains effective under rando

translated_title: 化学反应模型中超越端点对齐的涌现转向
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.21423v1 公告类型：cross。摘要：用于化学反应预测的机器学习模型通常以端点准确率作为评估标准，但仅仅端点的正确性并不能揭示模型如何表示化学转化，也无法解释模型为何失败。我们提出了 UniRxnAxis，这是一个统一的前向反应-逆合成框架，将两个任务都建模为共享潜在空间中的方向条件端点重分布。通过对齐源状态、转化状态和编码后的目标端点，UniRxnAxis 使得对模型学到的潜在更新进行方向性审计成为可能。这种共享的潜在几何结构允许将学到的位移（从编码器源状态 $S_0$ 到面向解码器的转化状态 $S_1$）分解为端点平行分量和端点正交残差，我们将后者称为“涌现转向”（emergent steering）。我们的评估表明，涌现转向在功能上是重要的：在逆合成任务中，它恢复了模型的大部分效用，并在随机……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 UniRxnAxis 统一框架，将前向反应预测与逆合成建模为共享潜在空间中的方向条件端点重分布，并证明学到位移中端点正交的“涌现转向”残差在功能上至关重要，能恢复模型在逆合成中的大部分效用。
en_tdlr: UniRxnAxis unifies forward reaction prediction and retrosynthesis as direction-conditioned endpoint redistribution in a shared latent space, and shows that the endpoint-orthogonal "emergent steering" residual is functionally crucial, recovering most of the model's utility in retrosynthesis.
